models.validity: Constant dB losses; equal wavelength/channel input. No BER/OMA/TDECQ model. Rate 1–400G is arithmetic scope, not physical feasibility.
models.assumptions: Launch is per wavelength per ELS output, before ideal fanout + excess loss. Same-wavelength Tx fibers are grouped by splitter fanout; ELS outputs = ceil(Tx fibers / fanout) × wavelengths. Unused branches in the last group consume optical allocation. Receiver sensitivity is average-power threshold at detector-side reference plane for the selected lane/rate; user must supply a compatible value.

models.validity: Typed compact bundle graph; explicit single-stage splitter fanout, constant dB losses. Virtual channels are not physical device-level simulation.
models.assumptions: Graph paths, FAU channel allocations, electrical connectivity and per-component loss determine results. Rx incoming power defaults to Unknown. No BER/EO/CMT/thermal-temperature model.
